description.value: OPA! of Greece is a Canadian quick-service restaurant chain founded in 1998 specialising in Greek-inspired grilled souvlaki, gyros, wraps, and platters. This Victoria location sits inside the Bay Centre mall in the city's downtown core. Touring cyclists passing through downtown Victoria will find a fast, filling stop with a menu heavy on protein and grilled fare.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The OSM record identifies a Victoria franchise of the Canadian Greek QSR chain OPA! of Greece; the corporate website at opaofgreece.com confirms the chain is active, and the contact-us page lists 'Bay Centre, Victoria' as a selectable store location, confirming this franchise exists and is operational. The website is a corporate/national site with no location-specific details, so the OSM phone (+1 250 590-0016, a BC area code) cannot be cross-verified against the website. No amenity details such as bike parking, washrooms, or Wi-Fi are mentioned anywhere in the website content.
concerns: OSM address field is incomplete (only addr:unit=100, no street); inferred as Bay Centre based on contact-us store list.
Corporate website shows Calgary HQ phone/address; the specific Victoria location phone (+1 250 590-0016) could not be verified against the website.
No street address in OSM — listing may need address verification.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, operational franchise restaurant confirmed active in downtown Victoria via the corporate website store locator. A useful refuelling stop for touring cyclists.

Vegetarian / vegan / GF.detail: Menu includes falafel snack bites and spanakopita (both vegetarian/vegan), as well as multiple salad options
